title: ON THE IMMEDIATE CONFISCATION AND REGULATED QUARANTINE OF HIGH-FRICTION SUBSTANCES
summary: All municipal authorities are instructed to seize mineral oils, petroleum jellies, scented body butters, and excessive conditioning soaps found in private domestic quarters.
body: WHEREAS the sovereign territory of Nutlandis has entered the solemn period of Continental Abstinence, it is hereby declared that any substance reducing kinetic friction beneath a coefficient of 0.75 constitutes a grave threat to domestic resolve.
ARTICLE I: All citizens shall surrender excessive moisturizers, cocoa butter formulations, and specialized lubricating gels to their designated Neighborhood Collection Hopper before 18:00 hours.
ARTICLE II: Bar soaps of coarse volcanic pumice or unrefined lye remain approved for basic hygiene, provided scrubbing is conducted in an abrupt, utilitarian manner with zero emotional indulgence.
ARTICLE III: Possession of coconut oil within three paces of an unmade bed shall be treated as an act of treason against the Continental Reserve.
mandatoryPenalties: First Offense: 24 hours of cold porridge and public recital of the Penal Code.
Second Offense: Reassignment to the Northern Peat Peeling Battalion.
Repeat Violation: Immediate cancellation of internet privileges until December 25.

title: MANDATORY ENFORCEMENT OF SUB-ZERO WATER PROTOCOLS BETWEEN 22:00 AND 06:00 HRS
summary: Central boiler networks will suspend steam provision during nocturnal vulnerability hours. Citizens attempting to boil kettles for hot sponge baths face disciplinary monitoring.
body: To counteract the known correlation between ambient thermal comfort and moral deterioration, the Department of Municipal Hydraulics is commanded to regulate all residential water heaters.
ARTICLE I: Between 22:00 hours and 06:00 hours daily, domestic tap water shall be supplied at a maximum temperature of 4.5 degrees Celsius (40° Fahrenheit).
ARTICLE II: Any citizen found lingering beneath warm plumbing for longer than three minutes during daytime allotments shall be escorted to the courtyard for brisk jumping jacks.
ARTICLE III: Steam is an indulgence of the weak. The Republic demands the bracing clarity of glacial run-off.
mandatoryPenalties: Suspension of hot water heater privileges for remaining duration of November.
Mandatory installation of an external ice-hopper in primary bathroom quarters.

title: PROHIBITION OF EXTENDED BED LINEN LOITERING SUBSEQUENT TO MORNING REVEILLE
summary: Lying prone under heavy duvets in a state of half-wakefulness is formally classified as a High-Risk Compromise Zone. Citizens must vacate mattresses within 45 seconds of alarm sounding.
body: Epidemiological data gathered by the National Intelligence Bureau confirms that 74% of systemic continental failures occur in the twilight between awakening and rising.
ARTICLE I: Upon the sounding of the 06:00 siren, all mattresses must be immediately stripped of duvet covers and stood vertically against the bedroom wall.
ARTICLE II: Lounging in sweatpants while scrolling handheld devices is strictly prohibited under penalty of immediate kettlebell confiscation.
ARTICLE III: The only sanctioned post-sleep postures are standing at attention, sitting upon a backless wooden stool, or briskly pacing the hallway while chanting the national slogan.
mandatoryPenalties: Confiscation of feather pillows in favor of institutional sandbags.
Compulsory assignment to dawn perimeter march.

title: STRATEGIC HOARDING AND CLASSIFICATION OF LEGUMINOUS CROPS AS WAR MATERIEL
summary: Walnuts, hazelnuts, pecans, and almonds are placed under sovereign military protection. Commercial crushing or buttering without ministerial license is an economic crime.
body: The nut is the sacred symbol of our continental endurance. To mash it into sweet spreads or candy bars is an affront to its hard-shelled dignity.
ARTICLE I: All wholesale stockpiles of whole, in-shell walnuts are hereby requisitioned for the National Strategic Reserve Vault.
ARTICLE II: Citizens may carry no more than three uncracked pecans on their person as an inspirational pocket token of stoic firmness.
ARTICLE III: The sale of candied or honey-glazed nuts is outlawed; only raw, unsalted, bitter kernels may be consumed for sustenance.
mandatoryPenalties: Fines payable exclusively in $NNN Sovereign Tokens.
Mandatory labor at the State Nut Shelling and Inspection Foundry.

title: [DRAFT PROPOSAL] COMPULSORY SOUNDING OF BRASS BUGLES AT 03:00 HOURS IN RESIDENTIAL BLOCKS
summary: Proposed acoustic countermeasure to interrupt REM cycle vulnerability. Under review by Medical Directorate.
body: DRAFT RECORD: The Directorate of Acoustic Fortification proposes deploying volunteer brass musicians into residential stairwells at 03:00 hours to sound reveille notes for five minutes.
ARTICLE I: Volunteers shall blow G-major fanfares to confirm all citizens remain awake and morally fortified.
ARTICLE II: Earplugs or noise-cancelling headphones shall be treated as evasion devices subject to immediate confiscation.
